subject: Onsite check-in kiosk flow & Redwood liaison plan for Horizon exec visit
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Spencer <rachel.spencer@horizonenergy.com>, John Liu <john.liu@horizonenergy.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onsite check-in kiosk flow & Redwood liaison plan for Horizon exec visit

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for hosting the exec workshop on 2025-11-25. To make arrivals and security simple for your team and ours, I put together a short operational plan and a proposed liaison schedule. Please see the attached files (onsite_plan_v1.pdf and badge_template.csv) and confirm two quick items: your IT/security POC for badge provisioning, and whether Horizon will allow temporary RFID badges or if we need to use escorted-only access for our attendees.

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Pre-register 12 guest badges using badge_template.csv (name, company, badge type) — ideally 48 hours before the visit.
- Confirm primary IT/security contact for day-of enrollment and network-guest provisioning.
- Approve our proposed kiosk flow (brief below) or flag any corporate requirements.

Proposed check-in kiosk flow (for your security team):
1) Kiosk greeter (Horizon desk or Redwood contractor) scans QR on pre-registration email or takes government ID.
2) Kiosk prints temporary badge (RFID or printed) and captures photo.
3) Badge labeled with "Redwood Guest - Exec Workshop" + escort rules ("Unescorted" or "Escort required").
4) If escort required, security receives a webhook/alert and escorts guest to meeting suite.

Internal liaison proposal: Laura Bennett will be on-site as Redwood liaison and point person for badge exceptions; Rishi will manage travel/welcome logistics (parking passes, arrival manifests).

Attachments: onsite_plan_v1.pdf (walkthrough + map), badge_template.csv (CSV for badge upload).

Can you confirm your preferred arrival window (we currently have guests at 08:30 and 09:15) and whether Horizon needs a separate contractor background check for our onsite AV team?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0122

Attachments: onsite_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 150KB), badge_template.csv (CSV, 1KB)

From: Rachel Spencer <rachel.spencer@horizonenergy.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, John Liu <john.liu@horizonenergy.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite check-in kiosk flow & Redwood liaison plan for Horizon exec visit

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the plan and attachments. Confirming a few items from Horizon:
- Primary security POC for badge provisioning and day-of is John Liu (copied). He handles contractor onboarding and badge prints.
- We can support temporary RFID badges for guests — RFID provisioning will require guest name, company, and email, and we need those uploaded 48 hours prior. Your badge_template.csv is perfect.
- AV contractor personnel do require a light background check (standard for our R&D floors). Can you share the AV team member names by Monday 11/23?

Arrival windows are fine — 08:30 for senior execs and 09:15 for the broader workshop group. One note: we have a dedicated kiosk terminal at Lobby B but if you prefer a roaming tablet for QR check-in we can provision a Wi-Fi guest SSID for the device.

Quick Q: will Redwood staff need long-term building access after 18:00? If so we need badge hold approvals.

Best,
Rachel Spencer
Director, Corporate Events
Horizon Energy
rachel.spencer@horizonenergy.com
+1 206-555-4490

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Spencer <rachel.spencer@horizonenergy.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 11:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite check-in kiosk flow & Redwood liaison plan for Horizon exec visit

Thanks John/Rachel/Vivek —

I'll take the liaison lead on-site. Action items for Redwood Ops: 
- I will upload the badge CSV by Wednesday 11/19 10:00 PST.
- I'll coordinate AV names to comply with Horizon background checks and send them by Monday 11/23 as requested.
- I'll create a one-page arrival manifest for the security desk with arrival windows and vehicle license plates where available.

I've attached the liaison_roster.xlsx with the provisional staff list and mobile numbers for day-of contact. If Horizon can provide the Lobby B kiosk Wi-Fi SSID and any captive portal instructions, please send those to me directly (laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com).

Cc'ing Rishi to confirm parking and swag drop-off (Rishi: can you confirm whether we need a pallet delivery slot or a single package for box drops?).

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: liaison_roster.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onsite check-in kiosk flow & Redwood liaison plan for Horizon exec visit

Perfect — thank you, Rachel and John.

Summary of agreed items (so everyone's aligned):
- Horizon (John) will provision RFID badges via upload; Laura will submit badge_template.csv by 11/19 10:00 PST.
- Redwood will send AV contractor names by 11/23 for the background check.
- Lobby B kiosk Wi-Fi details to be shared with Laura; Redwood to confirm whether we'll use printed badges or RFID at arrival.
- Rishi will confirm parking/pallet logistics by Friday.

Laura — please prepare the day-of liaison card (names, phone, badge exceptions) and leave one copy with Horizon reception.

I'll also upload the finalized onsite plan to the shared planning sheet and send a DocuSign envelope for the visitor NDA for execs who haven't completed it yet: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-12345

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to a smooth visit.

Best,
Vivek
